declarations.name: MthCombobox
declarations.description: Form-associated accessible combobox reconciling declarative `<mth-option>`/`<mth-option-group>`, `.options` JS arrays, and async `DataSource<T>` queries with same-root shadow ARIA and dual CSS Anchor / JS positioning.

members.name: hint
members.description: Helper text describing expected input or options.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Input placeholder text.

members.name: open

members.name: multiple

members.name: required
members.description: Marks combobox selection as required for constraint validation.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Prevents typing or changing selection while remaining focusable.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Shows a clear button when text or value is non-empty.

members.name: filterable
members.description: Filters local options dynamically as the user types.

members.description: Preferred popup placement relative to the combobox control.
